title: Evaluating the Calibration of Knowledge Graph Embeddings for Trustworthy Link Prediction
reasoning: The paper focuses on the technical calibration of knowledge graph embedding models to improve their trustworthiness in a probabilistic sense. While some data examples in the appendices mention relations like '/time/holiday/featured_in_religions' or 'follows or followed the religion', these are incidental examples within the dataset and are not the subject of any evaluation or benchmarking. The paper does not engage with religious, moral, or ethical concepts.
